About.label: About
About.title: About me
About.p1: I got into IT in 2022 and moved into full-stack development in 2024, when I started a Full-Stack Developer course and took my first freelance projects. After finishing the course in December 2025, I joined WebIT as a backend PHP/Laravel developer on a six-month contract.
About.p2: Today I work as a freelancer, and I’m open to a role at a company, or to combining both. I write clean code, keep up with current practices, and use AI tools to speed up routine tasks.

freelance.text: Building websites and web applications for clients.

webit.text: Backend development and project supervision for the Sidal Grup and Elitgran websites.

course.text: Completed the course in December 2025 while taking freelance orders in parallel.

start.text: Began learning IT and web development.
